Numerical results are provided in the metrics and comparison table below.
Sensitivity--Proportion detected among patients with LNM
Specificity--Proportion correctly negative among patients without LNM
Accuracy--Proportion classified correctly among all patients
ROC AUC--Discrimination; independent of the selected threshold
Positive predictive value (PPV)--Proportion with LNM among positive predictions
Negative predictive value (NPV)--Proportion without LNM among negative predictions
